name: Should I DIY custom trim or hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Should I DIY custom trim or hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: DIY can work for small, simple baseboard projects, but custom profiles, crown molding, and uneven rooms are much easier to get wrong. If you want a cleaner finish, faster turnaround, or help with repairs behind the trim, hiring a professional is usually the safer choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY is fine for simple trim in straight, easy rooms, but custom or detailed work is much harder to finish well. A professional is usually worth it when the room is uneven or the finish needs to look seamless.
